title: MyMedicalCabinet: medical history object types, save and delete actions, patient links

arguments.description: One per MyMedicalCabinet patient: the single-value fields of a MedicalHistory document (blood type, height, weight, social history, past medical and family history checklists) plus familyHistory[] as familyHistoryJson, sent from MongoDB by the Foundry bridge. Test members only until a HIPAA BAA. See docs/foundry-bridge.md 5.2 row 5 and 5.3.

displayMetadata.description: Primary key: the MedicalHistory _id (one MedicalHistory document per patient). Never changes.
MedicalHistory _id in MongoDB, for tracing back
familyMemberId ?? userId of the MedicalHistory document. Foreign key to MmcPatient.mmcKey
userId: the login that owns the record
Empty = the account holder's own record
Always hand-entered (Epic never writes these fields)
A+, A-, B+, B-, AB+, AB-, O+, O-, unknown
JSON array of familyHistory[]: condition, relationship, notes
